review_evidence: README describes a formalization following Browning--Lichtman--Teräväinen on bounds for exceptional abc triples.
Four of five Lean files contain proposition declarations, including the determinant, Thue, Fourier and geometry-of-numbers bound infrastructure in Section4.lean.

summary: Reviewed ABC-Exceptions; retain the ongoing formalization of power-saving bounds for the exceptional set in the abc conjecture.
